evidence: Frozen workbook Quality Checks!A2:D2 and Internal Quality Checks!A2:D2 define this row as a cold-read natural product request; no applicable internal cell annotation was present. The frozen instruction.md:1 opens in first person ("I'd like a small playground") and names the editor, preview, console and shared library as desired product outcomes. Line 3 gives the lived problem ("The annoying part is losing something that was working") and explains why last-good preview and version recovery matter. Line 7 asks to save and return to a draft, and to make the interface usable by keyboard and on a narrow screen. The only paths are handoff and runtime pointers at lines 5 and 9; there is no numbered acceptance list, feature matrix, mandated frontend framework, endpoint inventory or build recipe. The six notes add operational detail after the brief; integration.md says the frontend tools and routes/file layout are up to the builder. A plausible broken app could still be submitted against this naturally phrased request, but that is an app/scoring issue, not a row-1 wording defect. A conforming alternative using a different frontend stack or interface labels is allowed by the wording, so this row does not impose an implementation-specific false failure. Evidence files: per-row-review/evidence/01/instruction-lines.txt and workbook-row.json. The raw evidence index has 83/83 matching artifact hashes (per-row-review/evidence/01/raw-index-hashes.json); its scripted browser claims are not configured judge, Oracle, target-model or portal measurements and are not needed to judge this textual row.
